summary: Iter 51 — Central Catalog Manager (Explorer) verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS on the public preview URL covering /meta capability matrix (super/admin/user), /children lazy navigation at every level (root life areas, sub-area returns 7 org-types, org_type returns 5 PNRAG buckets), role gates on POST scenarios/decision-templates/solution-templates (plain admin → 403, super_admin → 200), admin can_store_crud creating an auto-approved Solution Store item, full scenario lifecycle (create → add decision template + store item → DELETE without cascade → 409 with detailed message → DELETE with ?cascade=true → 200 returning deleted_decision_templates / unlinked_store_items), and seed-scenarios-from-templates (super_admin → 200 returning scenarios_created/skipped_existing/templates_unmatched; admin → 403). Frontend: /admin/login → /admin/catalog verified for both super_admin and plain admin. Super-admin sees 'Super Admin · full structure CRUD' banner + Verify backbone / Migrate scenarios buttons; plain admin sees 'Admin · Solution Store & ReviewNet (auto-approved); structure read-only' banner with those buttons HIDDEN. Lazy tree expand confirmed (Finance → 8 sub-areas: Income, Expenses, Savings·7sub, Investments·8sub, Debt·7sub, Risk Management·7sub, Cash Flow & Liquidity, Financial Planning & Goals·5sub). All 10 L0 life areas render with correct names/icons/sub counts. No React Native red screens, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage in this feature, no shadow* issues introduced by this screen (only generic console warnings from other parts of the app).

issues: Interactive elements (chevron toggle, add/edit/delete/ratings icon buttons, Verify backbone, Migrate scenarios, refresh, sheet Cancel/Save, type chips, TextInputs) all use accessibilityLabel only — NO testID. Functional today but limits future Playwright automation; recommend adding testIDs like catalog-row-{node.id}, catalog-add-{node.id}, catalog-edit-{node.id}, catalog-delete-{node.id}, catalog-seed-backbone, catalog-migrate-scenarios, catalog-editor-save, catalog-editor-cancel, catalog-input-{field.key}.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID props to /admin/catalog Pressable/TouchableOpacity rows, icon buttons (add/edit/delete/ratings), seed/migrate/refresh buttons, and editor-modal inputs/buttons so future agents can automate UI flows reliably.

(Nice-to-have) Surface the 409 cascade-confirmation showAlert text on web — current showAlert uses native Alert API which may fall back to window.confirm on web; verify the 'Delete all' destructive option is reachable via web Pressable.

(Optional) Decision/Solution-Template forms currently lack a 'Decision type' picker — they accept any free text. If product wants a controlled vocabulary, add a chip picker similar to solution_item type.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/catalog_explorer.py is well-structured (~660 LOC, under the 700 threshold). Capability matrix _caps() and the three guards (_require_admin / _require_full / _require_store) correctly mirror the product rules.

DELETE /scenarios cascade behaviour is correct: hard-deletes children in cce_decision_templates / cce_solution_templates, but only $pull-unlinks solutions_store items (preserves canonical store records) — that matches the design note in the file.
POST /solution-items correctly stamps approval_status='approved' + is_authorized=true for any admin role (auto-approval requirement satisfied).

seed-scenarios-from-templates is idempotent (matches by title+catalog_node_id with 'individual'+'general' bucket) and creates helpful indexes on first run. ⚠️ Minor nit: when existing && force, code currently increments skipped instead of overwriting — the 'force' branch is effectively a no-op. Not blocking (default usage uses force=false), but the force=true UX is misleading. Consider deleting the duplicate scenario before re-inserting when force=true, or remove the force parameter from the API.

/admin/catalog index.tsx (≈620 LOC, just under threshold) — clean lazy-load pattern (cache by parent key), parent-after-mutation refresh keeps expanded state, 409 cascade confirmation flow is implemented and routes through showAlert with destructive option. Editor modal supports all 4 entity types with proper picker for solution_item.type.
No HTML elements; all rendering via View/Text/TouchableOpacity/StyleSheet — RN-compliant. SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context (correct). Uses expo-router useRouter properly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (capability banner + lazy expand to L1 sub-areas + role-gated controls visible/hidden as designed)

rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Feature works as specified across all 7 listed test scenarios.
